title: Information security policy suite
control_statement: A board-approved security policy suite exists, is reviewed at least annually, is version controlled, and each policy names an accountable owner and the standards that implement it.
evidence_requirement: Approved policy documents with version history; approval record naming the approving body and date; annual review record; policy-to-standard mapping table.
test_procedure: Select the policy suite index. Confirm each policy has an approval record within 12 months, a named owner still employed in that role, and at least one implementing standard. Confirm the version in the document repository matches the version published to staff.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Approval and review are human governance acts; only the review-due tracking automates.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Security roles, responsibilities and decision authority
control_statement: Security roles, decision rights, escalation paths and risk-acceptance authority are defined, documented and communicated, with segregation between those who operate a control and those who verify it.
evidence_requirement: Charter or equivalent authority document; RACI; delegation-of-authority records; org chart extract showing the operate/verify split.
test_procedure: Trace three enforcement decisions from the prior year to the authority that made them. Confirm the decider held the documented authority at the time and that the verifier was not the operator of the control.
automation_label: Manual by nature (judgement, negotiation, or physical observation)
automation_rationale: Authority is an organizational construct; no system holds it as machine-readable state.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Risk acceptance and exception governance
control_statement: Deviations from security standards are registered, time-bounded, compensated, approved at an authority tier proportional to residual exposure, and void on expiry.
evidence_requirement: Exception register extract with tier, accepter, expiry and compensating controls; risk acceptance records; evidence of void/closure actions for expired items.
test_procedure: Sample 15 open exceptions. Confirm each has a named accepter with documented authority for its tier, an expiry within policy maximum, a stated exit condition, and evidence that the compensating controls are operating. Confirm zero items past expiry without a void record.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Register state, aging and expiry are automatable; tiering and compensating-control adequacy are judgements.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Compliance obligation register
control_statement: Applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual security obligations are identified, recorded with their source, assigned to an owner, and mapped to the controls that satisfy them.
evidence_requirement: Obligation register with citation, owner, applicable scope and mapped control IDs; evidence of review following any regulatory change.
test_procedure: Confirm the register covers every regime in the declared scope profile. Select three obligations and confirm the mapped controls exist in the library and are implemented in the scope the obligation applies to.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Regulatory change monitoring can be fed by subscription services, but applicability is a legal judgement.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 SOX GDPR

title: Enterprise security risk assessment
control_statement: A documented risk assessment methodology is applied at least annually and on material change, producing scored risks with named owners and treatment decisions.
evidence_requirement: Methodology document; completed assessment with scoring inputs; risk register entries created or updated; evidence of assessment following a material change.
test_procedure: Confirm the most recent assessment is within 12 months and covers all in-scope systems. Select five risks and trace the score to its documented inputs. Confirm a material change in the period triggered a reassessment.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Scoring and scenario construction are analytic work; only register mechanics automate.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Risk register and treatment tracking
control_statement: A single enterprise risk register records inherent and residual scoring, treatment decision, owner, target date and evidence, and is reviewed on a defined cadence by severity.
evidence_requirement: Register extract with all mandatory fields populated; review meeting minutes; evidence of treatment progress for a sample of entries.
test_procedure: Confirm no register entry lacks an owner or a review date within its cadence. Recompute residual scores for five entries from the recorded control state. Confirm accepted risks carry a valid acceptance record.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Field completeness, aging and cadence compliance are machine-checkable; scoring is not.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 SOX GDPR

title: System categorization and impact levels
control_statement: Each system is categorized by the confidentiality, integrity and availability impact of its data and function, and the categorization drives the control baseline applied to it.
evidence_requirement: System inventory with categorization, data types and rationale; baseline assignment per category; approval by the system owner and the data owner.
test_procedure: Select five systems across categories. Confirm the categorization matches the data actually processed (sampled from the data inventory) and that the applied baseline matches the category.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Categorization can be inherited from the data inventory once that is reliable; the initial determination is judgement.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Hardware asset inventory
control_statement: An authoritative inventory of hardware assets is maintained with owner, location, criticality and network zone, reconciled against at least two independent discovery sources.
evidence_requirement: Inventory export; reconciliation report showing discovery-source deltas and their disposition; unowned-asset aging report.
test_procedure: Reconcile the inventory against endpoint-agent and network-discovery sources. Quantify assets present in one source and absent from the inventory. Confirm deltas older than 30 days have a disposition.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Discovery and reconciliation automate well; ownership assignment and disposition of orphans require a human.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX

title: Software inventory and authorized software
control_statement: Installed software is inventoried, compared against an authorized-software list, and unauthorized or end-of-support software is identified with a remediation or acceptance record.
evidence_requirement: Software inventory export; authorized list with approval dates; end-of-support report with dispositions; acceptance records for any retained unsupported software.
test_procedure: Sample 20 endpoints and 10 servers. Confirm installed software appears in the inventory within the collection interval. Confirm every end-of-support item has a dated remediation plan or a valid acceptance.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Collection and end-of-support comparison automate; the authorized list is a governance artifact.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX

title: Data inventory and classification
control_statement: Data stores holding regulated or sensitive data are inventoried with data type, classification, lawful basis where applicable, retention period, owner and geographic location.
evidence_requirement: Data inventory with the mandatory fields; discovery-scan results for regulated data types; sign-off by each data owner.
test_procedure: Run discovery for the regulated data types against a sample of stores not listed in the inventory. Any positive result is a completeness finding. Confirm classification labels match the data found.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Discovery tooling finds candidate stores; classification and lawful-basis determination are human judgements with legal input.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO SOX GDPR

title: Software bill of materials generation and maintenance
control_statement: A machine-readable SBOM is generated for every product release and material internal application, in CycloneDX 1.7 or SPDX 3.0.1 format, retained per release and updated on component change.
evidence_requirement: SBOM artifacts per release with format and timestamp; pipeline configuration showing generation is a build step; retention index linking SBOM to release identifier.
test_procedure: Select three releases. Confirm an SBOM exists, parses against its schema, and lists components matching the build manifest. Confirm the SBOM is retained and retrievable for the oldest supported release.
automation_label: Evidence generated and validated by machine with no human step
automation_rationale: Generation, schema validation and retention are entirely mechanical once wired into the build.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 CIP

title: Account lifecycle management
control_statement: Accounts are created from an authorized request, modified on role change, and disabled within defined intervals of separation, with privileged accounts held to a shorter interval.
evidence_requirement: Joiner/mover/leaver tickets with approvals; HR termination feed reconciled against account state; deprovisioning latency report by account type.
test_procedure: Reconcile all terminations in the period against account state. Compute the latency distribution. Any privileged account active beyond the defined interval after separation is an exception requiring an incident record.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Reconciliation is automatable once the HR feed is authoritative; approvals remain human.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Least privilege and role definition
control_statement: Access is granted through defined roles carrying the minimum privileges required, with standing privileged access eliminated in favour of time-bound elevation where technically feasible.
evidence_requirement: Role definitions with entitlement contents and approver; standing-privilege inventory with trend; elevation request records.
test_procedure: Enumerate accounts holding tier-0 privileges. Confirm each is either a break-glass account under the break-glass control or has an approved standing-privilege exception. Sample five roles and confirm entitlements match the definition.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Enumeration automates; role right-sizing is an analytic exercise with business input.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Periodic access certification
control_statement: Access to in-scope systems is reviewed by an accountable business reviewer on a defined cadence, with revocations executed and verified within a defined interval of the decision.
evidence_requirement: Campaign records with reviewer identity, decisions and timestamps; revocation tickets with completion evidence; reviewer-level approve-all-rate report.
test_procedure: Select two campaigns. Confirm every entitlement in scope received a decision, that revocations were executed within the interval, and that reviewers with an approve-all rate above the threshold were re-reviewed. Confirm no reviewer certified their own access.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Campaign mechanics and revocation verification automate; review quality is the residual human problem and is itself measurable.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Privileged access brokering and session recording
control_statement: Privileged sessions to in-scope systems are brokered through a managed path with credential injection, session recording and automatic credential rotation.
evidence_requirement: Broker configuration export; session recording index with retention; rotation logs; list of privileged targets not yet brokered with acceptance records.
test_procedure: Attempt a direct privileged connection bypassing the broker from a representative network position; the attempt should fail or generate an alert. Confirm recordings exist for a sample of sessions and that credentials rotated after use.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Configuration state, rotation and recording completeness are machine-verifiable; the bypass test is a human exercise.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Remote access control
control_statement: Remote access to internal and industrial networks requires multi-factor authentication, terminates at a controlled boundary, and is logged with session attribution.
evidence_requirement: Remote access configuration; authentication policy showing factor requirement; session logs with user attribution; list of remote-access paths reconciled against the network diagram.
test_procedure: Enumerate all inbound remote access paths from external scanning and firewall configuration. Confirm each terminates at a controlled boundary and enforces multi-factor authentication. Any undocumented path is a finding.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Path enumeration and policy state automate; reconciliation against intent needs an engineer.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Separation of duties
control_statement: Incompatible duties are identified and enforced so that no single individual can author, approve and deploy a change, or grant and use privileged access, without detection.
evidence_requirement: Conflict matrix defining incompatible duty pairs; entitlement analysis showing conflicts; mitigating-control records where a conflict is unavoidable.
test_procedure: Run the conflict matrix against current entitlements. Confirm every detected conflict has a documented mitigating control with evidence it operates. Test one deployment path to confirm the author cannot self-approve.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Detection automates once the conflict matrix exists; defining the matrix is business analysis.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 SOX

title: Multi-factor authentication
control_statement: Interactive human authentication to in-scope systems requires a second factor, with phishing-resistant factors required for privileged and externally reachable access, and every exemption registered with an expiry.
evidence_requirement: Authentication policy export; enforcement report by population with denominator definition; exemption register with expiry dates.
test_procedure: Confirm the enforcement denominator includes legacy-protocol and shared-station paths. Attempt authentication from an unenrolled context and confirm the challenge. Confirm every exemption has an unexpired registration.
automation_label: Evidence generated and validated by machine with no human step
automation_rationale: Policy state and coverage are fully machine-readable; only the denominator definition requires human agreement, and it is the part most often wrong.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Authenticator management
control_statement: Credential issuance, strength, storage, rotation and revocation follow a defined standard, and shared or non-attributable credentials are prohibited for privileged use.
evidence_requirement: Credential policy configuration; vault inventory with rotation timestamps; report of accounts with non-expiring or shared credentials and their dispositions.
test_procedure: Query for accounts with non-expiring credentials, credentials older than the rotation interval, and accounts flagged as shared. Confirm each has a disposition. Confirm no shared credential holds privileged entitlements.
automation_label: Evidence generated and validated by machine with no human step
automation_rationale: Directory and vault state expose all of this directly.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Non-human identity governance
control_statement: Every service account, workload identity and API credential has a named human owner, a documented purpose, a scoped entitlement set, and a rotation or attestation record.
evidence_requirement: Non-human identity inventory with owner, purpose, entitlements and last rotation; ownerless identity aging report; decommissioning records.
test_procedure: Confirm the inventory reconciles with directory and cloud IAM enumeration. Sample ten identities and confirm the owner acknowledges ownership and the entitlements match the stated purpose. Any ownerless identity older than the threshold is a finding.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Enumeration and rotation state automate; ownership attribution is the hard, human part and is where these programs stall.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX

title: Secure configuration baselines
control_statement: Hardening baselines derived from a recognized benchmark are defined per platform, approved, applied at build, and measured for conformance in production.
evidence_requirement: Baseline definitions with benchmark provenance and approved deviations; build images referencing the baseline; conformance scan results by platform.
test_procedure: Scan a sample of production hosts per platform against the baseline. Compute conformance. Confirm each deviation is either an approved baseline exception or a finding with a remediation record.
automation_label: Evidence generated and validated by machine with no human step
automation_rationale: Conformance scanning is fully automatable; deviation approval is governance.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Change management and approval
control_statement: Changes to production systems follow a documented process with risk assessment, testing, authorization by someone other than the implementer, and a rollback plan.
evidence_requirement: Change records with approval identity and timestamp, test evidence, and rollback plan; emergency-change records with post-hoc approval; unauthorized-change detection report.
test_procedure: Sample 25 production changes including 5 emergency changes. Confirm approval preceded implementation (or followed within the emergency window), that the approver differs from the implementer, and that test evidence exists. Reconcile deployed changes against change records to detect unrecorded changes.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Ticket-to-deployment reconciliation automates; the approval judgement does not.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX

title: Vulnerability scanning coverage
control_statement: Authenticated vulnerability scanning covers the in-scope estate on a defined cadence, with coverage measured against the reconciled asset inventory rather than the scanner's own target list.
evidence_requirement: Scan schedules and completion records; coverage report using the inventory as denominator; authentication success rate by platform; list of unscannable assets with compensating controls.
test_procedure: Compare scanned assets against the reconciled inventory. Confirm coverage meets target and that unscanned assets have a documented reason. Verify authenticated scanning actually authenticated by sampling scan detail.
automation_label: Evidence generated and validated by machine with no human step
automation_rationale: Fully automatable once the inventory denominator exists; without it the coverage number is meaningless regardless of automation.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Remediation within severity-based service levels
control_statement: Identified vulnerabilities are remediated within intervals set by severity and exposure, with overdue items escalated and any deferral recorded as a time-bound exception.
evidence_requirement: Remediation records with detection and closure timestamps; aging report by severity; escalation records for overdue items; exceptions for accepted vulnerabilities.
test_procedure: Compute time-to-remediate distributions by severity against the SLA. Confirm overdue items were escalated per policy. Confirm accepted items have valid, unexpired acceptance records with compensating controls.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Measurement automates; the remediation work and the SLA negotiation do not.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Penetration testing
control_statement: Independent technical testing is performed at defined intervals against internet-facing systems, internal networks and products, with findings tracked to closure.
evidence_requirement: Scope document and rules of engagement; test report with methodology; finding tracker with closure evidence; retest results for high-severity findings.
test_procedure: Confirm scope covers the systems the framework requires. Trace each high finding to closure evidence or an acceptance record. Confirm retesting occurred for remediated high findings.
automation_label: Manual by nature (judgement, negotiation, or physical observation)
automation_rationale: Testing is expert human work; only the finding tracking automates.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Endpoint protection and detection
control_statement: Endpoints and servers run a managed protection agent in prevention mode, with coverage measured against the reconciled inventory and agent health monitored.
evidence_requirement: Agent coverage report reconciled to inventory; policy export showing prevention mode; agent health and last-check-in report; list of unprotected assets with compensating controls.
test_procedure: Reconcile agent console inventory against the asset inventory in both directions. Confirm prevention mode is enforced, not merely available. Execute a benign detection test on a sample host and confirm the event reaches the console.
automation_label: Evidence generated and validated by machine with no human step
automation_rationale: Coverage, policy state and health are console-readable; the reconciliation denominator is the only judgement.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Patch management
control_statement: Security patches are evaluated, tested and deployed within intervals set by severity and system class, with unpatchable systems compensated and registered.
evidence_requirement: Patch deployment reports by system class with timestamps; evaluation records for systems on a mandated evaluation cycle; compensating-control records for unpatchable systems.
test_procedure: Sample systems per class and confirm current patch level against the applicable interval. For regulated cycles, confirm an evaluation record exists within the mandated period even where no patch was applied.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: State and deployment automate; validated and industrial systems require change windows and human coordination.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Software authenticity and integrity verification
control_statement: Software and firmware installed on production and product systems is verified for authenticity and integrity before installation, using vendor signatures or hash verification.
evidence_requirement: Verification records or pipeline configuration showing signature checks; artifact repository policy; exception records where verification is not technically possible.
test_procedure: Select five recent installations including one firmware update. Confirm verification occurred and was recorded. Attempt to install an unsigned artifact in a test context and confirm it is rejected.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Pipeline enforcement is automatable; vendor-supplied industrial firmware often is not, which is where the exceptions concentrate.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX

title: Audit log generation standard
control_statement: In-scope systems generate audit records for authentication, privilege use, configuration change and data access, containing the fields required to attribute an action to an identity.
evidence_requirement: Logging standard defining required events and fields; per-platform configuration evidence; log-source inventory with onboarding status against the standard.
test_procedure: Select five platforms. Confirm the required event classes are produced with the required fields. Perform a test action of each class and confirm a corresponding record appears.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Configuration verification automates; defining what must be logged is engineering judgement.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Log retention, protection and integrity
control_statement: Audit records are retained for the period required by the most demanding applicable obligation, protected from modification by the subjects they record, and access to them is itself logged.
evidence_requirement: Retention configuration per log store; access control on the log platform; integrity mechanism description; retention-period mapping to each obligation.
test_procedure: Retrieve a record from the earliest retained date and confirm completeness. Confirm administrators of source systems cannot alter or delete records in the log store. Confirm log-platform access is logged.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Retention and access state are readable; obligation mapping requires legal and compliance input.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Security monitoring and detection content
control_statement: Security-relevant events are monitored against version-controlled detection content mapped to adversary techniques, with alert disposition recorded and content effectiveness reviewed.
evidence_requirement: Detection content repository with commit history; technique coverage mapping; alert disposition records; tuning change log with rationale.
test_procedure: Select five detections and confirm each has a documented technique mapping, a test result, and a defined response action. Review disposition records for a sample period and confirm closed-as-false-positive items produced a tuning action or a documented decision not to tune.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Content deployment and alert mechanics automate; authorship, tuning judgement and coverage assessment do not.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Incident response plan and severity model
control_statement: A documented incident response plan defines severity levels, declaration authority, roles, communication paths and regulatory triggers, and is exercised at least annually.
evidence_requirement: Current plan with version and approval; severity definitions with declaration authority; exercise report with participants, scenario and identified gaps; gap remediation tracker.
test_procedure: Confirm the plan is within its review period and reflects the current organization. Confirm the annual exercise occurred, included executive participants, and that gaps identified have owners and dates.
automation_label: Manual by nature (judgement, negotiation, or physical observation)
automation_rationale: Plans and exercises are human artifacts; only version and review tracking automate.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Incident detection, triage and escalation
control_statement: Security events are triaged against defined criteria, escalated within severity-based intervals, and recorded with a timeline sufficient to reconstruct the response.
evidence_requirement: Incident records with detection, triage, escalation and containment timestamps; escalation criteria document; on-call roster covering the stated coverage window.
test_procedure: Select five incidents including one at high severity. Confirm escalation occurred within the interval, that the timeline is reconstructable from records, and that the declared severity matches the criteria.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Timestamps and workflow automate; triage judgement is the control.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Regulatory and contractual breach notification
control_statement: Incidents meeting regulatory or contractual thresholds are assessed for notification obligations and reported within the applicable clock, with the assessment recorded whether or not notification was required.
evidence_requirement: Notification assessment records including the no-notification determinations with reasoning; submitted notifications with timestamps; obligation matrix showing clocks per regime and contract.
test_procedure: For every incident in the period at or above the assessment threshold, confirm a documented notification determination exists. For any notification made, confirm it was within the clock. Confirm the obligation matrix covers all regimes in the scope profile.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Clock tracking can be automated once the determination is made; the determination is legal judgement and cannot be.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO CIP GDPR

title: Post-incident review and corrective action
control_statement: Incidents at or above a defined severity receive a documented review identifying contributing factors and corrective actions with owners and dates, tracked to closure.
evidence_requirement: Post-incident review documents; corrective action tracker with closure evidence; evidence that recurring contributing factors are escalated.
test_procedure: Select three qualifying incidents. Confirm a review occurred within the defined interval, that corrective actions have owners and dates, and that overdue actions were escalated. Check whether the same contributing factor appears across multiple reviews.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Action tracking automates; the analysis is the deliverable and it is entirely human.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Backup and verified restore
control_statement: Backups of in-scope systems and data are taken on a defined schedule, stored with at least one immutable or offline copy, and validated by actual restore tests rather than job-success status.
evidence_requirement: Backup job reports; immutability or offline-copy configuration; restore test records naming the system, data set, date, duration and outcome.
test_procedure: Select two Tier-1 systems and require a restore to an isolated environment. Measure actual restore duration against the stated recovery objective. A job-success report alone does not satisfy this test.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Job state automates; restore validation requires an environment and a person, and is the part most often skipped.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Disaster recovery objectives and testing
control_statement: Recovery time and recovery point objectives are defined per system tier from a business impact analysis, and recovery capability is tested against those objectives.
evidence_requirement: Business impact analysis with tier assignments; documented RTO/RPO per tier; recovery test reports showing achieved versus target; gap remediation plans.
test_procedure: Confirm every Tier-1 system has a documented RTO/RPO traceable to the impact analysis. Review the most recent test and compare achieved recovery to target. Confirm gaps have funded plans.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Test execution and measurement are largely manual exercises involving business stakeholders.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Encryption in transit
control_statement: Data in transit across untrusted networks, and regulated data across internal networks, is protected with current cryptographic protocols and validated certificate handling.
evidence_requirement: Protocol and cipher configuration per service; external scan results showing negotiated protocols; certificate inventory with expiry monitoring; exception records for legacy paths.
test_procedure: Scan in-scope endpoints and confirm deprecated protocol versions and weak ciphers are refused. Confirm certificates are valid, in-date and issued by an approved authority. Confirm legacy exceptions are registered.
automation_label: Evidence generated and validated by machine with no human step
automation_rationale: Scanning and certificate inventory are fully automatable.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Encryption at rest
control_statement: Regulated and sensitive data at rest is encrypted with approved algorithms, with key access separated from data access.
evidence_requirement: Encryption configuration per data store; algorithm and key-length evidence; key access policy showing separation from data-plane roles; inventory of unencrypted stores with acceptance.
test_procedure: Enumerate data stores from the data inventory and confirm encryption state for each. Confirm that a data-plane administrator cannot retrieve keys. Any unencrypted regulated store is a finding.
automation_label: Evidence generated and validated by machine with no human step
automation_rationale: Cloud and database platforms expose encryption state directly; the only gap is knowing which stores exist, which is AM-03's problem.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Cryptographic key management
control_statement: Cryptographic keys are generated, stored, rotated, revoked and destroyed under a documented policy, with access restricted and all key operations logged.
evidence_requirement: Key management policy; key inventory with type, purpose, owner, creation and rotation dates; key-store access logs; rotation and destruction records.
test_procedure: Sample five keys across purposes. Confirm rotation occurred within the policy interval, that access is restricted to authorized roles, and that key operations appear in the log. Confirm destroyed keys are recorded as destroyed.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Managed key services expose lifecycle state; policy definition and exception handling are human.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 GDPR

title: Data retention and secure disposal
control_statement: Data is retained no longer than its defined retention period and is disposed of using methods that prevent reconstruction, with disposal recorded for regulated data and media.
evidence_requirement: Retention schedule by data type with legal basis; deletion job records or certificates of destruction; media sanitization records; legal-hold register showing suspended deletions.
test_procedure: Select three data types and confirm data older than the retention period is absent, or covered by a documented legal hold. Confirm media disposal in the period produced sanitization records.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Automated deletion is achievable in modern stores and rarely implemented in legacy ones; physical media disposal is manual by nature.

title: Personnel screening and access authorization
control_statement: Personnel are screened commensurate with the sensitivity of the access they will hold, before access is granted, and re-screened where the regime requires it.
evidence_requirement: Screening completion records linked to access grant dates; role-to-screening-level matrix; re-screening records where required; contractor screening attestations.
test_procedure: Sample ten access grants to sensitive systems and confirm screening completed before the grant date at the required level. Confirm contractor screening attestations exist and are current.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Completion state can be tracked in HR systems; the screening itself and its adjudication are human processes with legal constraints that vary by jurisdiction.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Role-based security competence
control_statement: Personnel in roles with security responsibilities receive role-specific training appropriate to those responsibilities, with completion tracked and competence assessed for specialized roles.
evidence_requirement: Role-to-curriculum mapping; completion records by role; assessment results for specialized roles such as secure development and industrial control engineering.
test_procedure: Confirm every role in the mapping has an assigned curriculum and that completion meets the threshold. For specialized roles, confirm competence was assessed rather than only attended.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Completion tracking automates; competence assessment requires role-specific evaluation.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Physical access control
control_statement: Physical access to facilities, data centres, control rooms and network cabinets is restricted, logged, reviewed, and revoked on separation or role change.
evidence_requirement: Badge system access lists by zone; access logs; periodic review records; revocation records reconciled against HR separations; visitor logs for restricted zones.
test_procedure: Reconcile badge access for restricted zones against current authorization. Confirm separations in the period resulted in badge deactivation within the interval. Observe whether tailgating controls operate at one restricted entrance.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Badge state and reconciliation automate; physical observation of control effectiveness does not.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Media handling and removable media control
control_statement: Removable media use is restricted by policy and technical control, media containing regulated data is tracked, and media entering industrial environments is scanned before connection.
evidence_requirement: Endpoint policy showing removable media restrictions; exception register; industrial media scanning station records; media tracking log for regulated data.
test_procedure: Attempt to write to removable media from a standard endpoint and from an industrial workstation and confirm the policy result. Confirm scanning station records exist for the period. Confirm exceptions are registered with expiry.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Endpoint policy state automates; the industrial scanning step is a procedural control depending on operator behaviour.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Secure development lifecycle gates
control_statement: Product and application development follows a defined lifecycle with security requirements, threat modelling, security testing and a release gate that records the disposition of open findings.
evidence_requirement: Lifecycle procedure; threat models per product with review dates; gate records per release showing open findings and their disposition; evidence of gate enforcement in the pipeline.
test_procedure: Select two releases. Confirm a threat model exists and was reviewed within the period, that the gate record lists open findings with dispositions, and that any override carries a named approver.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Gate enforcement automates; threat modelling is expert work and is the input the gate depends on.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 SOX GDPR

title: Application and dependency security testing
control_statement: Application code and third-party dependencies are tested for known vulnerability classes at defined pipeline stages, with severity-based thresholds that block release.
evidence_requirement: Pipeline configuration showing test stages and thresholds; scan results per build; suppression register with justification and expiry; dependency inventory with known-vulnerability status.
test_procedure: Confirm the pipeline enforces the threshold by inspecting a build that exceeded it. Review the suppression register for expired or unjustified entries. Confirm dependency scanning covers transitive dependencies.
automation_label: Evidence generated and validated by machine with no human step
automation_rationale: Entirely automatable; the human work is threshold setting and suppression review, which is where the control actually fails.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 GDPR

title: Product security postmarket obligations
control_statement: Products placed on regulated markets maintain a vulnerability disclosure path, postmarket monitoring of component vulnerabilities, and a documented process for assessing and communicating security updates over the supported lifetime.
evidence_requirement: Published disclosure policy and intake records; postmarket monitoring records linking SBOM components to vulnerability sources; update assessment decisions with clinical or operational risk input; customer communications.
test_procedure: Confirm the disclosure path is reachable and intake is triaged within the stated interval. Select one component vulnerability affecting a supported product and trace the assessment decision and customer communication.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: SBOM-to-advisory matching automates; the safety and clinical risk assessment for each update cannot be, and it is the rate-limiting step.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443

title: Environment separation and non-production data
control_statement: Development, test and production environments are separated, and production regulated data is not used in non-production without approved de-identification.
evidence_requirement: Environment architecture showing separation controls; data-provisioning procedure for non-production; de-identification method documentation; scan results for regulated data in non-production stores.
test_procedure: Run regulated-data discovery against non-production environments. Any positive result without an approved de-identification record is a finding and a potential notifiable event. Confirm developers cannot reach production data stores directly.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Discovery scanning and access-path testing automate; de-identification adequacy is a judgement requiring privacy input.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 SOX GDPR

title: Vendor security assessment and tiering
control_statement: Third parties are tiered by the access and data they hold, assessed before onboarding at a depth matching their tier, and reassessed on a tier-based cadence.
evidence_requirement: Vendor register with tier, access type, data types and assessment dates; completed assessments with findings and dispositions; reassessment schedule and compliance against it.
test_procedure: Confirm tiering criteria are applied consistently by sampling ten vendors and re-deriving their tier. Confirm Tier-1 vendors were assessed before access was granted and reassessed on cadence. Confirm findings have dispositions.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Register and cadence tracking automate; assessment itself is analyst work and does not scale with automation.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Contractual security requirements and flow-down
control_statement: Contracts with third parties handling enterprise or regulated data include security requirements, breach notification obligations, audit rights, and flow-down to subprocessors.
evidence_requirement: Executed agreements with the security schedule; processor agreements and business associate agreements where applicable; subprocessor registers; evidence of notification-clause review.
test_procedure: Sample five contracts across tiers. Confirm the security schedule is attached and current, that breach notification intervals meet the enterprise's own regulatory clocks, and that a subprocessor list exists where required.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Contract metadata can be tracked; drafting and negotiation are legal work.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 CIP SOX GDPR

title: Supplier component provenance
control_statement: Software and hardware components entering products or production systems are sourced from identified suppliers, with provenance recorded and component-level vulnerability monitoring in place.
evidence_requirement: Supplier list per component; ingested supplier SBOMs; provenance records in the artifact repository; monitoring configuration linking components to vulnerability feeds.
test_procedure: Select three components in a shipped product. Confirm the supplier is identified, that an SBOM or equivalent component list was ingested, and that the component is under vulnerability monitoring.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Ingest and monitoring automate where suppliers provide machine-readable SBOMs; supplier non-participation is the binding constraint, not tooling.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 CIP

title: Records of processing and lawful basis
control_statement: Processing activities involving personal data are recorded with purpose, categories of data and subjects, recipients, transfers, retention and lawful basis, and kept current.
evidence_requirement: Records of processing with all required elements; review records; transfer mechanism documentation; linkage from each record to the systems in the asset inventory.
test_procedure: Select three processing activities and confirm the record matches actual system behaviour, including recipients and transfers. Confirm the record was reviewed within the period and that a lawful basis is stated for each purpose.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Records can be partially derived from the data inventory, but purpose and lawful basis are legal determinations.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP ISO GDPR

title: Data subject rights fulfilment
control_statement: Requests from individuals to access, correct, delete, restrict or port their personal data are received, verified, actioned and answered within the statutory period, with the outcome recorded.
evidence_requirement: Request register with receipt, verification, action and response dates; response templates; evidence of fulfilment in source systems; records of refusals with the exemption relied upon.
test_procedure: Sample five requests including one refusal. Confirm identity verification occurred, the statutory clock was met, and the action was actually executed in the source systems rather than only recorded. Confirm refusals cite a valid exemption.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Workflow and clock tracking automate; locating and actioning data across systems is manual wherever the data inventory is incomplete.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA ISO GDPR

title: Data protection impact assessment
control_statement: Processing likely to result in high risk to individuals is assessed before it begins, with mitigations identified, residual risk recorded, and consultation escalated where required.
evidence_requirement: Screening records showing which activities required an assessment and which did not; completed assessments with mitigations and residual risk; sign-off; consultation records where applicable.
test_procedure: Identify new or materially changed processing in the period. Confirm screening occurred for each and that assessments exist where the threshold was met. Confirm identified mitigations were implemented rather than only proposed.
automation_label: Largely manual; automation limited to reminders and workflow state
automation_rationale: Screening can be embedded in intake workflow; the assessment is legal and analytic work.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP ISO GDPR

title: Zone and conduit segmentation
control_statement: Industrial networks are divided into zones with defined security levels, and traffic between zones traverses conduits with explicitly enumerated, owned and reviewed allow rules.
evidence_requirement: Zone and conduit model with assigned target security levels; firewall rule base with owner and justification per rule; rule review records; flow analysis showing actual traffic against permitted flows.
test_procedure: Compare the rule base against the zone model. Any any/any rule or rule without an owner is a finding. Sample permitted flows and confirm they are still required by the operating process.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Rule analysis automates; the zone model and the judgement that a flow is still required are engineering work with plant operations.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP

title: Industrial remote and vendor access
control_statement: Remote access to industrial systems, including vendor access, is brokered through a controlled path, enabled only for the duration of an approved activity, and recorded.
evidence_requirement: Access request and approval records with time windows; jump host configuration; session recordings; vendor access register with contractual basis.
test_procedure: Confirm no persistent vendor access path exists by enumerating inbound paths to the industrial zone. For three vendor activities, confirm an approval preceded access, the window matched, and a recording exists.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Path enumeration and session state automate; the approval and the operational coordination do not.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP

title: Unsupported industrial system compensations
control_statement: Industrial systems that cannot be patched or cannot run standard protective agents are inventoried, isolated to an enumerated flow set, monitored, and covered by a time-bound, compensated acceptance.
evidence_requirement: Inventory of unsupported systems with OS version and constraint reason; firewall policy restricting each system; monitoring configuration; current acceptance records with compensating controls and expiry.
test_procedure: Confirm the inventory reconciles with the OT asset inventory. For each system, confirm the restricted flow set is enforced and that an unexpired acceptance exists. Confirm systems under a prescriptive regulatory patch regime are handled under that regime and not under enterprise acceptance.
automation_label: Evidence extractable on demand; human assembles and attests scope
automation_rationale: Inventory and policy state automate; the acceptance lifecycle and the regulatory carve-out are governance work.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 FEDRAMP ISO IEC62443 CIP

title: Boundary protection
control_statement: Enterprise network boundaries are defined, traffic crossing them is controlled by default-deny policy, and the externally reachable surface is enumerated and reconciled against intent.
evidence_requirement: Boundary device configuration with default-deny evidence; external attack surface enumeration; reconciliation of discovered services against an approved exposure register.
test_procedure: Run external enumeration against the published address space. Compare discovered services to the approved exposure register. Any unregistered externally reachable service is a finding regardless of its vulnerability status.
automation_label: Evidence generated and validated by machine with no human step
automation_rationale: External enumeration and configuration comparison are fully automatable and cheap; the approved exposure register is the human-maintained half.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR

title: Egress control and data movement monitoring
control_statement: Outbound traffic from environments holding regulated data is restricted to approved destinations and protocols, and bulk or anomalous data movement is detected.
evidence_requirement: Egress policy configuration; approved destination register; detection rules for anomalous volume or destination; alert disposition records.
test_procedure: Attempt an outbound connection to an unapproved destination from a regulated environment and confirm the result. Review detections for bulk movement in the period and confirm each was dispositioned.
automation_label: Evidence extracted by scheduled job; human reviews exceptions only
automation_rationale: Policy enforcement and volumetric detection automate; defining 'approved destination' for a real business is the slow part.
mapped_frameworks: N53 CSF SOC2 HIPAA FEDRAMP CMMC ISO IEC62443 CIP GDPR
